dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Good morning, private banking, Rachel Bennett speaking. How can I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hello, Rachel. It's Adrian Cole. I'm back from a business trip and wanted to discuss my portfolio before my next meeting. I'd appreciate keeping the conversation fairly brief.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Of course. Have you had a chance to settle back into the office, or are you still travelling?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I'm back in the office, although it feels as though I've spent more time with our distribution teams than at my own desk lately. Calling is much easier than arranging a branch visit.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Telephone contact is fine for our discussion. We can keep the administrative conversation here rather than arrange a visit. I'll let you get your notes in front of you before we begin.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: They're here. Let me give you my details. My identification number is T three four five seven five nine zero L. My date of birth is 29 November 1987.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. Let me distinguish the holdings we're discussing. For comparison, there's Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, which is a pooled emerging-market debt investment. Then there's Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031, the individual corporate bond already in your portfolio.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The latter, the individual bond you just mentioned, is the holding I want to transact in.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I recommend reducing Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031 because the holding concentrates your credit exposure in an individual issuer. Reducing it would lessen that concentration and the need to monitor that issuer closely.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Mm, I hear you. I'm distracted by my meeting; let me think about it.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: We can pause the conversation here. You don't need to keep talking while you're being interrupted. Would telephone contact still be the most convenient way to pick up the discussion?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, please keep contact by telephone. I'm usually moving between the office and the warehouse, so a branch appointment is awkward. I'll call when I have some privacy and my meeting is out of the way.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian. When you call, you can ask for Rachel Bennett. If I'm unavailable, please leave a callback message without including any sensitive details.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That's helpful. I need to step into the meeting now. Thank you for your time, Rachel.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Thank you for calling, and goodbye.
